cohort: The study collected data from existing hospital records and interviewed staff at five public health facilities in an Indian State.
finding: The study estimated health system package costs for various family planning methods and pregnancy-related services in India, with costs ranging from 807 for condoms to 22,136 for caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The cost of antenatal care along with vaginal delivery was 10,916, while caesarean delivery cost 22,136.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for services provided over the last one year from existing hospital records.
